Initial release: Instantly create and export polished branded videos from images or clips with cloud-based processing.

- Turn five product photos and a logo into a fully edited 1080p video within 1-2 minutes.
- No timeline editing or export settings needed—just upload files and describe your desired result.
- Automatic cloud session setup; free 100-credit anonymous login available.
- Supports batch edits, timeline previews, and iterative adjustments in a persistent session.
- Handles text overlays, music, and multiple export formats (mp4, mov, gif, etc.).
- Full workflow and error handling documented for smooth use and troubleshooting.
